description: This file implements WebSocket protocol handling, including frame encoding/decoding, request/response key generation, and managing WebSocket frames within a WebSocketLink class. It references external cryptographic functions and manages internal state for WebSocket communication.

classes.name: Protocol
classes.description: Handles WebSocket protocol specifics such as key generation, frame encoding, and decoding.

methods.name: Protocol::RequestKey
methods.description: Generates a WebSocket request key by creating random bytes and encoding them.

methods.name: Protocol::ResponseKey
methods.description: Computes the WebSocket response key based on the request key and a GUID.

methods.name: Protocol::Encoder
methods.description: Encodes data into WebSocket frames, handling masking, fragmentation, and control frames.

methods.name: Protocol::Decoder
methods.description: Decodes incoming WebSocket frames, handling unmasking, fragmentation, and frame validation.
